Hand-Carved Wooden Figurine
Man Smoking Pipe Folk Art Statue
Hand-Painted Carved Wood, Approximately 7.5 Inches Tall
This hand-carved and painted wooden figurine depicts a smiling rustic gentleman dressed in traditional European folk attire, complete with trousers, suspenders, an embroidered vest, and a stocking cap, holding a pipe to his lips. Executed in the traditional Alpine folk art woodcarving tradition, the piece features expressive, chisel-cut faceted detailing and rich, warm polychrome tinting that emphasizes the natural wood grain.
Solid natural wood construction with hand-chiseled facets and polychrome painted finish
Detailed character depiction featuring an old man smoking a pipe in traditional Alpine dress
Integrated rectangular carved wooden base provides sturdy freestanding display
Measures approximately 7.5 inches tall on a 3 by 2.5 inch base
Condition:
Hand-painted finish is well preserved with rich coloration and minor natural surface wear consistent with age. Wood carving is structurally sound with no major breaks, missing limbs, or visible repairs. Pipe stem and bowl remain intact. Bottom of the base is plain and unmarked with visible saw grain.
